                    ### Question

Serology of virus B: Anti-HBs and Anti-HBc positive. Ultrasound suggests grade I steatosis. What is the most likely diagnosis?

The positive Anti-HBs and Anti-HBc suggest previous hepatitis B infection, supporting the direct bilirubin predominance. The ultrasound findings of grade I steatosis align with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, further supporting the diagnosis.
